title: Resilient Consensus-Based Target Tracking under False Data Injection Attacks in Multi-Agent Networks
summary: Distributed target tracking in multi-agent networks plays a critical role in cooperative sensing and autonomous navigation. However, it faces significant challenges in highly dynamic and adversarial setups. This study aims to enhance the resilience of decentralized target tracking algorithms against measurement faults and cyber-physical threats, especially false data injection attacks.
